name: CWIP Asset Entry
description: CWIP asset capitalisation data entry widget

getLastEvent.description: Returns the last event payload. Split by '|' to parse.

getData.description: Returns all rows as a JSON string.

setData.description: Replaces all rows. Call this inside onDataChange after 'loadData' fires.

setCellValue.description: Sets a single cell value and re-renders.

setRowOptions.description: Sets searchable dropdown options for one cell.

onReady.description: Fires once when the widget is mounted. Use to load initial data.

onDataChange.description: Fires on every user interaction. Call getLastEvent() and split by '|'. Payloads: loadData | saveChanges|n | fieldChange|row|field|value | selectRow|row|true/false | selectAll|true/false | deleteRow|n | clear|n.

onValidate.description: Fires when Validate is clicked. getLastEvent() returns VALID|0 or INVALID|n.
